trade.text: Kelly backs President Trump's use of trade tools, including tariffs, to help American companies compete, and co-sponsored steel trade-enforcement legislation.
trade.quote: President Trump has committed to using every tool in the toolbox to ensure American companies can fairly compete in the global economy.

debt.text: Kelly says preserving and strengthening Social Security to improve retirement security is a top priority.
debt.quote: Starting with preserving and strengthening the Social Security system, Rep. Kelly's highest priority is to improve retirement security for older Americans today and for future generations.

schools.text: Kelly favors expanding parental choice in education and less federal control of schools.
schools.quote: We need to focus on expanding parental choice, enacting accountability, flexibility, and ensuring education is not being micro-managed at the federal level.

immigration.text: Kelly praised the Secure the Border Act and calls for curbing illegal immigration at the southern border.
immigration.quote: The Secure The Border Act takes a serious step toward curbing the surge of illegal immigration at our Southern border.

guns.text: Kelly calls himself a strong Second Amendment supporter opposed to government infringement on gun rights.
guns.quote: It protects law-abiding citizens from the government's infringement on our right to keep and bear arms.

abortion.text: Kelly identifies as pro-life and pledges to protect unborn life.
abortion.quote: I will continue to defend these unalienable rights, and work to protect the most vulnerable among us, especially the unborn.

health.text: Kelly worked to roll back the Affordable Care Act and opposes government-run health care in favor of market competition and patient choice.
health.quote: Healthcare should be affordable, accessible, and free from bureaucratic government interference.

energy.text: Kelly backs expanded domestic oil and gas production and criticizes policies that restrict fossil fuel energy.
energy.quote: Since day one in office, President Biden has waged war on American energy

tax.text: Wagner opposes the 2017 tax cuts and calls for tax policy in which the wealthy pay more so programs can be funded.
tax.quote: I will vote to pass tax policy that does not allow working-class families to pay a higher tax rate than billionaires.

wages.text: Wagner wants to raise the federal minimum wage, tie it to inflation, and pass the PRO Act to protect union organizing.
wages.quote: It's long past time to raise the federal minimum wage

debt.text: Wagner pledges to oppose any cuts to Social Security benefits, raising the retirement age, or privatization.
debt.quote: I will flatly oppose any effort to cut benefits, raise the retirement age, or privatize the system.

schools.text: Wagner opposes school vouchers that divert money from public school funding.
schools.quote: I do not support school vouchers that take away from public school funding.

immigration.text: Wagner calls for a path to citizenship, protecting DACA recipients, and expanding legal pathways for essential workers.
immigration.quote: Establish a workable path to citizenship, protect DACA recipients, and expand transparent, legal pathways for agricultural and essential workers who keep Western Pennsylvania's economy moving.

health.text: Wagner pledges to co-sponsor and vote for Medicare for All and to protect and expand the ACA.
health.quote: I will co-sponsor and vote to pass The Medicare For All Act (H.R. 3069).
